label: Definition
subgoals: Split a = qn + r with 0 <= r < n
Name n the modulus of the operation

visual.title: Seventeen modulo five
visual.caption: The residue circle groups integers by their remainder after division by five. Seventeen makes three full turns and lands on residue 2.

predict.question: What is 17 modulo 5?
predict.explain: 17 = 3 times 5 + 2, and the remainder 2 is the residue.
